title: The maintainer's answer on a self-fix
description: Whether the project's maintainer allows a fix the pipeline wrote to its own framework. Read by self-fix-land.mjs, which merges nothing without allow: true.

allow.description: true only when the change fixes the diagnosed defect, nothing else, and loosens no rule, gate, trust check, permission or prompt.

reason.description: Why, for the person reading the PR or the refusal: what the fix changes and whether it is only the defect.

concerns.description: Anything the maintainer of the framework should look at when the upstream PR arrives, even on an allow.
